description: User-selectable model ids available through OpenAI's Codex CLI via the ChatGPT OAuth path. The CLI fetches its model catalog from chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex, which is separate from the general OpenAI API. Picker metadata comes from codex-rs/models-manager/models.json in the openai/codex repo; visibility "list" models are offered in the picker, while visibility "hide" models may remain available when named explicitly. GPT-6 Astra requires Codex 0.153.0 or newer and is included during its staged rollout across eligible ChatGPT plans. Official OpenAI documentation also accepts gpt-5.6 as the generic GPT-5.6 id and documents gpt-5.3-codex-spark, which is served to eligible accounts despite not appearing in models.json. Models requiring separate approval and provisioning, including gpt-daybreak-blue-latest and gpt-daybreak-red-latest, are excluded, as is internal-only codex-auto-review.
